name: M365Gov_AiActivity

authoritativeControlOwner.name: The source AI platform and its native governance service
authoritativeControlOwner.sentinelRole: ASIM Agent Event normalization and correlation

nativePortalRoute.label: Microsoft Defender portal
nativePortalRoute.notes: Use the source-specific native route when the originating product provides one.

dependencies.name: ASIM Agent Event source parser
dependencies.owner: Microsoft Sentinel or the source integration owner

limitations: ASIM Agent Event source-parser coverage can lag the current schema.
CopilotActivity is not force-mapped because its audit semantics do not guarantee every Agent Event meaning.
When no valid parser exists, use source-specific audit queries rather than fabricating ASIM fields.
Request, response, thought-process, token, LLMEventData, and network Content fields are excluded.

missingSourceBehavior.description: Dependent content stays disabled and reports the dependency unavailable. No result is never evidence that no AI activity occurred.

privacy.identityHandling: Only normalized identifiers needed for correlation are returned.
